title: Clouds
subtitle: What are they up to?
summary: Learn to name every cloud you see, then work out why it formed and what it says about tomorrow. A halo round the Sun can mean rain within a day; towers at ten in the morning can mean a storm by four. Branches go into Northwest winter rain, tornadoes and hurricanes, and the 1946 attempts to make it rain with dry ice. A sky simulator and a stack of real photographs give you something to practise on.
